name: Bog Dragon (Adult)
savenote: +2 status to all saves vs. primal

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet DC 30 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Tail Lash
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within reach of the dragon's tail makes a Strike or attempts a skill check as part of an attack action

Effect The dragon Strikes with their tail at the triggering creature with a –2 penalty. If the Strike hits, the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the triggering roll.

Effect: Tail Lash

offensiveAbilities.name: Bog Rot
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 3d6 Acid Damage damage and Clumsy 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 4d6 Acid Damage damage, clumsy 1, and a –5-foot status penalty to Speed (1 day)

Stage 4 5d6 Acid Damage damage, Clumsy 2, and a –10-foot status penalty to Speed (1 day)

Stage 5 death

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Nidorous Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nidorous Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon belches a boiling spray of fermenting stomach acid that deals 9d8 Acid Damage damage in a 40ft Type:cone (Basic DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save). They can't use Nidorous Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slain to Serve
offensiveAbilities.description:
A bog dragon can perform a special ritual over the body of a humanoid creature slain by bog rot to raise it as a humanoid intelligent undead.

This functions like a 6th-rank Create Undead ritual, except that it takes only 8 hours, the bog dragon doesn't require any secondary casters, and they don't need to pay a cost.

If the bog dragon critically fails the ritual's skill check, they get a failure instead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swallow Whole
offensiveAbilities.description:
Large, (3d10+7) Acid Damage plus Bog Rot, Rupture [28]

See rules...

The monster attempts to swallow a creature of the listed size or smaller that it has grabbed or restrained in its jaws or mouth. If a swallowed creature is of the maximum size listed, the monster can't use Swallow Whole again. If the creature is smaller than the maximum, the monster can usually swallow more creatures; the GM determines the maximum. The monster attempts an athletics|defense:reflex check opposed by the grabbed creature's Reflex DC. If it succeeds, it swallows the creature. The monster's mouth or jaws no longer grab a creature it has swallowed, so the monster is free to use them to Strike or Grab once again. The monster can't attack creatures it has swallowed.

A swallowed creature is Grabbed, is Slowed 1, and has to hold its breath or start suffocating. The swallowed creature takes the listed amount of damage when first swallowed and at the end of each of its turns while it's swallowed. If the victim Escapes this ability's grabbed condition, it exits through the monster's mouth. This frees any other creature grabbed in the monster's mouth or jaws. A swallowed creature can attack the monster that has swallowed it, but only with unarmed attacks or with weapons of light Bulk or less. The swallowing creature is Off-Guard against the attack. If the monster takes piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding the listed Rupture value from a single attack or spell, the swallowed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either Escaping or cutting itself free can immediately breathe and exits the swallowing monster's space.

Effect: Engulf and Swallow Whole

If the monster dies, a swallowed creature can be freed by creatures adjacent to the corpse if they spend a combined total of 3 actions cutting the monster open with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swamp Passage
offensiveAbilities.description: The bog dragon ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
